message:
Plan B gives you later starts:

- Monday: 10 a.m. instead of 8 a.m.
- Wednesday: 1 p.m. instead of 8 a.m.
- Tuesday/Thursday: adds 10–11:40 a.m. classes, leaving 20 minutes before your noon work start.

B is better if avoiding early mornings matters most and that work transition is practical. A keeps Tuesday/Thursday mornings free. Both have the same Thursday 5:30–6:20 p.m. lab and satisfy all hard requirements at 13 credits.

Your saved Plan A and current enrollment remain unchanged. Plan B remains a draft.
